findings.exact_char_boxes_tried: splitting operators with the page's character boxes instead of a proportional share: y10 within-2pt 0.4070 vs 0.4073, many times slower; not used.
findings.y10_symbol_maths: 385 Symbol + 81 MT Extra glyphs in the source as U+F0xx; maths set with gaps ('( i - 1 )') that the render runs together ('(i-1)'). Residual after the new reading: subscripts set apart in the source ('H', '0') and run on in the render ('H0') -- deliberately NOT split (letter/digit boundaries are inside ordinary words: SHA256, x86).
findings.y24_leaders_cut_both_ways: old reading: 6,732 source '.' tokens, 6,729 matched (2,570 within 2pt); recall of everything else 0.4697. New word_recall 0.4856 (was 0.5493).
findings.y26_leaders: LO raw checkpoint render, old reading: 3,027 source tokens unmatched anywhere, 2,243 of them single '.' leader dots (LibreOffice drew fewer dots per contents line).
